assessments.reasoning: Design Overview makes the logical layer entirely Lisp and assigns buffer, streams and coordination to it. It gives device code a lower-level abstract file-device interface and leaves implementation details to particular devices.

limitations: This is a documented subsystem design. Target-specific device code, actual timing and the design of other Interlisp implementations remain separate.
